exposure: increased vascularity in the parametrial region
finding: Perioperative complications were found to be closely associated with PAS stage, with higher PAS categories experiencing greater operative time, blood loss, and rates of hysterectomy, blood transfusion, ITU/HDU admission, and longer postoperative admissions.
mod_finding: This study found a correlation between the stage of placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) and the need for cesarean section and hysterectomy, with higher PAS stages linked to increased surgical morbidity.
